title: Overwhelming World Cup and pre-season has not helped Vinicius' form
subtitle: Vinicius Junior has not hit his best form this season, but the Real Madrid star puts that down to a complicated and hectic summer.
paragraphs: Vinicius Junior said he was "overwhelmed" by a hectic summer in which he was at the centre of transfer speculation.
Real Madrid star Vinicius has yet to hit his best form this season, contributing to four goals (one goal, three assists) in his 12 appearances so far.
Vinicius was a high-profile transfer target for Arsenal in the summer, as he delayed signing a new contract at Madrid.
The winger eventually penned a long-term deal with Los Blancos, though his performance levels have not been up to par.
Indeed, he has been suspended for four games after a sending-off against Villarreal, with Yan Diomande coming in to impress in Vinicius' absence.
However, Vinicius feels his busy summer, which included a last-16 exit for Brazil at the World Cup, is at least partly responsible for his dip in form.

"I don't think I prepared as well as I could have after the World Cup because the impact of that tournament is so ⁠significant for all Brazilians," he told a press conference ahead of Brazil's friendly with Singapore.
"Being knocked out so early was something we hadn't expected. So, I took advantage of my holidays to enjoy myself, rest, relax, and spend more time with my family.
"I ended up training less than in previous years. That may have affected my start to the season.
"On ‌top ⁠of that, regarding my contract renewal, with so many clubs showing interest last summer, I felt truly overwhelmed, as with the situation at Real Madrid. But it's a very long season.
"Maintaining such a high level for so long is always very difficult.
"I think only Cristiano Ronaldo and [Lionel] Messi have managed to do this for so many years, reaching the same ⁠kinds of numbers. I am human, I often make mistakes, but I always try to improve."
